none: PAS FindID 997118: Lin-765F32: Roman nummus of Helena
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [FL IVL HE-LENAE AVG] ; R/ [PAX PV-BLICA]

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena (AD 324-341), dating to the period AD 337-340 (Reece Period 17). PAX PV-BLICA reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [FL IVL HE-LENAE AVG]. Reverse description: Pax standing facing left holding branch and transverse Sceptre. Reverse inscription: [PAX PV-BLICA]. Coin measures: 14.01 mm in diameter, 1.57 mm in thickness, and 1.24g in weight
